messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired — Service: gpu-memory-pressure-prod — severity: P1 — Alert PD-987654 — affected pool: gpu-pool-7 — 3/12 nodes showing OOMs — link: <https://redwood.infra/alerts/PD-987654>

pagerduty: PagerDuty: PD-987654 -> assigned to oncall-elena (ack required).

oncall-elena: Acked PD-987654, I'm taking this. Starting triage now. ETA to initial mitigation ~5m. :thumbsup:

sre-jordan: Any quick pointers from logs/dash? Seeing customer 5xxs?

oncall-elena: Dashboards show spike in cuda alloc failures and retries, error rate up for model-serving route /v1/generate ~12% failures last 5m. Notifying CS.

oncall-elena: paste logs: ```
2026-03-17T22:13:04Z gpu-pool-7-2 kernel: cuda: failed to allocate 1258291200 bytes
2026-03-17T22:13:04Z model-runner[pid:1245]: ERROR CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: 2
2026-03-17T22:13:05Z runtime: kvcache: allocation failed, evicting 0 entries
```

runtime-oliver: Looks like kvcache allocs are thrashing after the recent quantized rollout. Can we route traffic off gpu-pool-7 and reduce batch_size on the model? Suggest batch_size=1 and disable kvcache prefetch for the rollout.

infra-tim: I'm starting a drain of node gpu-pool-7-2 now: `kubectl drain gpu-pool-7-2 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — will cordon first.

oncall-elena: Confirmed cordon+drain kicked. Starting reroute of traffic away from pool-7 to pool-3 and pool-4.

cs-amy: Noted. Customer-impact: acct-green and acct-neo have elevated errors; acct-green is on a live demo. I'll open a short blurb to support and badge priority.

sre-jordan: Observability: OOM spikes at 22:14 UTC correlate with a model rollout 25m ago (quantized-gpt-large-v2). 78% of failures contain `kvcache` in stack. Possible memory regression or prefetch bug.

oncall-elena: Any recent infra changes?

runtime-oliver: There was a config flip enabling aggressive kvcache prefetch for quantized-gpt-large-v2 at 21:52. Rolling that back now: `infractl rollout undo quantized-gpt-large-v2 --reason="OOM regress, rollback kvcache prefetch"`

infra-tim: Rollback command issued, controllers converging. Drained node finished evacuating pods; restarting gpu-driver on node to clear residual allocations.

oncall-elena: PD note: mitigation in flight — drain + rollback + reroute. Will monitor for 10m.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: PD-987654 acknowledged by oncall-elena.

sre-jordan: After rollback + drain, OOM rate dropped to baseline in pool-7 within ~120s. Kernel OOM logs stop after 22:16:30 UTC.

oncall-elena: Confirming: errors for /v1/generate down to 0.8% over last 3m. Customers being routed back gradually.

cs-amy: Support message posted to affected accounts and escalated to account owners. Will follow up with customer notes.

infra-tim: Node gpu-pool-7-2 back to Ready after driver restart. No hardware faults detected.

runtime-oliver: I'll patch the prefetch safe-guard to prevent large simultaneous kvcache allocations and open a PR to add a memory headroom check before prefetched loads.

oncall-elena: Marking PD as resolved after stabilization, will file a short incident report and link postmortem. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: PD-987654 resolved by oncall-elena at 2026-03-17T22:18:00Z — auto-close in 30m unless updates are added.
